title: Gauge44 factory and whole-family assignment for conditional κ = 0.001649483702558979
body:
This extends the pinned [#635](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/635) construction with a changed arbitrary-helper-input factory and 44 rank-four cold endpoints. It is one new commit based on main at `17ce0c79b7b51c2634b439ea5a2b754f09909693`.

Under the retained all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, normalized wrappers, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact-recovery, analytic-transfer and bit H1–H5 interfaces,

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{1649483702558979}{10^{18}}=0.001649483702558979.
$$

The saving is **0.80931% above #635**. This compares exponent savings, not practical runtime. The conservative complex model separately certifies κ `0.001649483699681650`.

## Construction

Within each eight-source factory, exchange four source registers with equal clean copies at their common rank-one frame. This changes how arbitrary initial helper values propagate while preserving the clean operands. Complete the four coordinate totals to an invertible retired-row basis using frozen low-frame forms, and place available totals on source carriers.

The resulting protected-column and inverse-support calculation exposes 44 rank-four cold directions. Exact dyadic input premixes, low-frame tails and a recomputed FULL inverse realize them. Both row and column isolation are checked before removing an ended helper from cleanup. All scalar gates and dirty-input compensations are included in the finite invoice.

| Quantity per invocation | Complete #635 JP8 | Gauge44 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Source / target ports | 112 / 112 | 112 / 112 |
| Helper registers | 492 | 492 |
| Rank-four cold endpoints | 22 | 44 |
| Total helper residual width | 3,894 | 3,794 |
| Local paid rank mass | 5,750 | 5,650 |

All 72 invocations use the new supplier. An explicit assignment covers 35,424 helper roles, retaining 7,168 live and 7,670 physical families. The whole-family matcher concentrates idle remainders using a capacity exchange argument; 288 integer majorization receipts justify its updates. All 72 final callwise remainder histograms are optimal with the other calls fixed. No joint global optimality is claimed.

Every idle remainder is charged. The final global rank mass remains 520,704, with deficit 2,560 and largest child rank 48. The improved rank distribution certifies complex saving `0.001652208994368411824947`.

The unchanged [#543](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/543) bit supplier gives `0.001653826988146798944268`; **the complex side binds**. No bit improvement is claimed.

## Proof and validation

The incremental package is `research/gauge44-global/`.

- `CONSTRUCTION.md`: exact local construction, protected directions and full cleanup.
- `hosting/PROOF.md`: capacity, exchange and integer majorization proof.
- `independent/CENTRE-GUARD-REVIEW.md`: changed source carriers with the same ordered ports and center frames.
- `evidence/ASSEMBLY.json`: two exact rational moment engines, both complex models and all 47 strict outer inequalities per model.
- `construction/INPUTS.json`, `data/UPSTREAM-PINS.json`, `MANIFEST.json`: construction inputs, inherited dependencies and submitted-file hashes.
- `LOCAL-VALIDATION.json`: local incremental verification record.

After preparing the pinned #635 supplier as described in the README:

```sh
python -B research/gauge44-global/verify_manifest.py
python -B research/gauge44-global/construction/reproduce.py \
  --main . --pr635 /tmp/gauge44-pr635 \
  --out /tmp/gauge44-local --until phases
python -B research/gauge44-global/verify_global.py \
  --main . --local /tmp/gauge44-local/local --work /tmp/gauge44-global
```

Local incremental verification passed on Python 3.14.8: exact construction and recipe reconstruction; both native orientations on all 716 input columns; 3,019 directed phase edges and 224 endpoint adapters; independent scalar and retained-guard audits; exact owner reproduction and all 72 callwise fixed points; fresh controller, finite invoice and global assembly. All 15 controller mutations and 69 assembly admission mutations were rejected. The component rates and complete global profile match the frozen evidence; separate rational pricing reproduces the same κ.

Fresh phase timing changes the runtime plan hash and its template reference. Every other serialized template field matches the frozen template exactly. `LOCAL-VALIDATION.json` records both hashes; each runtime reference is checked against its actual file.

The dedicated CI workflow runs the changed construction, independent checks, owner replay and strict global admission on Python 3.11 and 3.14. Raw logs and optional research outputs are excluded from the submission. No predecessor full replay or PDF generation was performed.

Package manifest SHA256: `ad36e2c9802a8da4a4c70180eeb710d9f314b1e8cc521b5749d3fbebc299e932`.

Global template content SHA256: `0c2aab7dc120f5882a0171496cbbe819cac81373dcb425802a15f45e36898a46`.

This remains a finite conditional witness under the cited realization and analytic contracts. It does not claim an unconditional multiplication theorem or complete Lean formalization.
